scope: Independent prelaunch review of frozen source, package and bound local verification. Not cloud execution, speedup, OOF quality or cross-session recovery acceptance.
resolved_findings: prepare now verifies every data-review input hash and both reviewed CSV hashes/sizes before freezing.
prepare uses exact payload and embedded ZIP allowlists; full audit/holdout data are not uploaded.
launch inventories authenticated own notebooks across pages and fails closed on unavailable/repeated/capped pagination before any write.
guard claim uses a kernel-held nonblocking mutex covering the entire claim and lock retirement.
guard checks the correct selftests/*/jobs process-receipt paths and refuses a still-live previous worker.
scheduler checks already-failed active workers before refill and preserves unsuccessful attempts rather than overwriting.
job acceptance checks sparse file m/repeat, dense-subset IDs/true/plain scores, array shapes/dtypes, eligibility and routes.
guard records 30-second progress and measures its full process tree RSS.

reviewed_components.prepare_inputs: Frozen old EXP023 and accepted EXP043 derived mappings verified. Both arms have same 60 prompts, same 120 old job IDs and all metadata; only text/text_sha256 differ. Raw is old original120, not EXP042 aligned new120. Holdout groups and known/exact overlaps remain gated.
reviewed_components.prepare: Reviewed input identities frozen, precise allowed files, immutable baseline input/core hash checks, private CPU/offline metadata and two input sources.
reviewed_components.launch: Frozen manifest, code-review and current local-validation gates precede network writes. Exact own-ref absence inventory, durable in-flight status, one QuickSave and one run request, source/config readback, no automatic retries. Current installed Kaggle SDK signatures support all used parameters and response fields.
reviewed_components.validate_local: Records RUNNING before tests, runs bounded synthetic tests, real-payload no-training preflight and tiny real-StyleGrams parallel parity. PASS only after package/holdout/manifest checks. Logs and summary currently bound to final hashes.
reviewed_components.algorithm: compute_job follows frozen EXP042 add120 path: original official folds and ordered rows, per-fold train-only vocabulary/IDF, unchanged float64 core/LinearSVC C=.5 dual=True max_iter4000 seed42, old per-row weight denominator unchanged, new data in separate codex grouping block. Dense text-only grouping and select-then-regroup sparse inference preserved.
reviewed_components.scheduler: At most two worker processes, each task gets a unique arm/fold/attempt directory. Coordinator owns global state and seals successful jobs only after clean worker exit and output checks. Failures stop remaining workers and are never retried automatically.
reviewed_components.checkpoints: Completion receipt is written last with closed per-file hash/size inventory and whole algorithm/data/config/environment identity. Resume requires explicit flag and matching identity; completed jobs are verified/reused unchanged, unfinished attempts remain and use a new attempt directory.
reviewed_components.guard: Cumulative6600-second work budget across attempts,20GiB sampled process-tree RSS cap, PID/create-time/host/boot checks, explicit tree termination/wait. Unknown prior host/boot needs matching terminal tree-stop proof; lost guards consume conservative wall time, never reset budget.
reviewed_components.aggregation: Requires ten sealed jobs, official dense fold IDs/true-label alignment and complete2699-row OOF; guard revalidates all job receipts before COMPLETE. Full results still require external artifact and metric acceptance.

numerical_test.scope: small real StyleGrams numerical/concurrency test; not full model training or accuracy evidence

limitations: Local tests ran on numpy2.4.4/pandas3.0.6/scipy1.17.1/sklearn1.8.0/Python3.13.13. They are behavioral evidence only; cloud strict versions and its own numerical self-test must pass before full training.
Small synthetic parity covers one fold per arm and all16 dense/sparse outputs per arm; it does not prove full-data score equality or speedup. Both current arms require new fitting.

Checkpoint resume has been tested at scheduler level with completed-job reuse, identity/hash rejection and preserved incomplete attempts. Full cloud interruption/recovery and guard end-to-end recovery are not executed evidence.

New Kaggle runs do not inherit prior working files. Cross-session recovery needs actually published outputs downloaded and hash-verified, then reintroduced explicitly into the same frozen payload/output identity with retained budget. Current first-run launcher does not automate that transport.
Hard platform termination can prevent output publication. Missing checkpoint bytes or uncertain process inactivity fail closed; recovery is not guaranteed.
Lost-guard wall charging includes downtime and can exhaust remaining budget before a later recovery. RSS is sampled rather than an instantaneous OS hard limit.
Requested model labels do not authenticate provider snapshots. Known/exact separation does not certify complete semantic independence.
Official folds are previously inspected development validation. Only frozen raw120-vs-clean120 Stylegram effects may be inferred after acceptance, not full ensemble or leaderboard gains.
post_run_acceptance: Bind fixed notebook version/readback, run_id, config and code hashes before interpreting results.
Require guard/result/state COMPLETE, clean coordinator exit, tree_stopped true, no termination reason, cumulative budget and RSS receipts.
Verify cloud strict environment and cloud numerical selftest PASS with two workers observed.
Verify global inventory, ten sealed job receipts, full two-arm2699x18 OOF,150 sparse outputs and their exact ID/fold/label/scenario mapping.
Report actual wall time and peak RSS, not estimated parallel speedup. Compare frozen primary18-class OOF BA and paired official-prompt uncertainty without retuning.
Any later retry/resume is explicit and separately bound; no automatic cloud relaunch.
